summary: Defines how NETCONF, the protocol for configuring network devices, can deliver asynchronous notifications. An optional capability built on the base protocol, it specifies the operations and capabilities needed so a client can subscribe and be told about events on a device as they happen, rather than polling.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking your oven every minute whether the cake is done, you ask it to ring a bell. This lets a network device ring a bell when something happens.

questions: how to subscribe to netconf events
